# Screenshot 1 — Template Library (Maison Ember)

## 1) Nav tabs (top bar)
- **Main toolbar:** AI Studio (8+2), Motion (19), Library (23, active), Catalogue, Playbook (344), Forge, Concierge
- **Right side:** Edit text, Shuffle, Cruise, Evening, EM Emerald OS (dropdown)
- **Right panel tabs:** Genome (active), Tier, Build

## 2) Technical labels / jargon
Yes, several:
- **Right panel:** "TEMPLATE DNA", "SEVEN SWITCHES", "0/3 used", "Reset", "PRESETS" — informative UI labels, not really dev jargon
- **Switch list:** "01 Colour atmosphere — As drawn", "02 Typographic voice", "03 Light", "04 Material", "05 Density", "06 Motion", "07 Contrast" — each tagged "As drawn"
- **Template metadata:** "Nocturne", "LIGHT: Cormorant Garamond / Inter", "MOTION: Art-directed", "CORNERS: 2px"
- **Left sidebar:** "TEMPLATES", category headers (Food & Beverage, Healthcare & Wellness, Legal, Home Services, Property & Real Estate), counts (5, 4, 4, 6, 4), and a small **teal chip "KIT"** next to "Nightflow 24/7 Plumbing"
- No module names like SiteHeader appear in this screenshot.

---

# Screenshot 2 — Module Forge

## 1) Nav tabs (top bar)
- **Top-right:** Library, Catalogue, Playbook
- (Top-left is a breadcrumb-style header, not tabs: "Library / Module Forge — 344 modules · any module · any template · rendered live")

## 2) Technical labels / jargon
Yes, this screenshot is full of them:
- **Left module list** — internal module names with tier chips:
  - STARTER: **SiteHeader**, **MobileNav**, **SiteFooter**, **AnnouncementBar**, **Breadcrumb**, **SkipToContent**, **CookieConsent**, **ErrorBoundary**, **NotFound**
  - GROWTH: **MegaMenu**, **StickyActionBar**, **BackToTop**, **ThemeToggle**, **SearchOverlay**
  - BUSINESS: **LanguageSwitcher**, (partially visible "...ndPalette" — likely BrandPalette), **OfflineBanner**
  - Each with caption "01 · Global system modules"
- **Tier filter chips:** "All" (dark chip), Starter, Growth, Business, **Flagship**
- **Count label:** "344 OF 344 SHOWN"
- **Dropdowns:** "TEMPLATE: Food & Beverage — Maison Ember (Flagship)" and "SLOT: Mid page — Mounted in the body rhythm, after the primary action"
- **Status toast:** "Compiling…" (dark pill, bottom-left)
- **Overlay copy:** "Pick a module — any of the 344. It mounts on Maison Ember in that template's own skin..."
- Header subtitle: "344 modules · any module · any template · rendered live"
